metric_definitions.brier: Existing evaluator binary mean squared probability error; valid probabilities only. Matched Brier contrasts use the common valid-probability rows, with coverage stated.
metric_definitions.conditional_accuracy: Correct divided by valid delivered rows. Always report alongside planned correctness and coverage.
metric_definitions.cost: Sum known conservative usage once per actual new job, retain any unknown reservation in full. Historical aliases have zero incremental cost, with historical provenance separate. Never sum cumulative ledger snapshots.
metric_definitions.order_consistency: Compare semantic option identity across the two reversed presentations; report valid-pair denominator and all-planned both-correct rate.
metric_definitions.planned_correct: Correct and valid delivered rows divided by every originally planned ordered row; invalid, absent, uncertain, held or unadmitted rows contribute zero correct.
